question: Who are the top 5 spenders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC, c.name LIMIT 5

question: Who are the top 10 spenders?
